تشترفون (form VIII)
# تَشْتَرِفُونَ (taštarifūna) /taʃ.ta.ri.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# تُشْتَرَفُونَ (tuštarafūna) /tuʃ.ta.ra.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
